episodes.title: Jonestown Massacre [ Apocalyptic Cult ] Who Was Jim Jones _ _Mystery _ Makeup - GRWM_ Bailey Sarian
episodes.description: The Jonestown massacre remains one of the most shocking tragedies in modern history. Who was Jim Jones, and how did an apocalyptic cult leader convince hundreds to follow him? Investigators pieced together fragile clues, forensic evidence, and survivor accounts to uncover the truth. Join Bailey Sarian as mystery and makeup collide in this gripping true crime story. Press play and listen now.
